references.text: The land had rest for forty years after Othniel delivered Israel—the same wording about peace in the land after a judge delivered the people.
The land had rest for forty years after Deborah and Barak's victory—a similar concluding formula about a period of peace.
Moab was humbled, and the land had rest for forty years under Gideon—the same pattern of the enemy's humiliation followed by a period of peace.
Moab's fall is mentioned in Moses' song—historical background for Moab as Israel's enemy.
The Lord gave Israel's enemies rest on all sides during David's reign—the same theme of God's gift of peace to His people.
Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms and had peace—Moab under Israel's dominion fulfilled on a larger scale.
Saul waged war against Moab and other enemies—ongoing conflict between Israel and Moab throughout history.
